d: Kavya is set to marry Anand, but during their wedding rituals, it is revealed that Kavya's mother is pregnant, hiding a secret behind the situation.
Two daughters-in-law, troubled by their mother-in-law's attempts to divide them, create a window in the wall to share their joys and sorrows with each other.
A daughter-in-law juggles various challenges in her quest to define herself through relationships, family obligations and societal expectations.
A man who is a firm believer of Lord Shiva, a Hindu God, experiences numerous hardships in life. Owing to his dedication, Lord Shiva himself comes down to Earth to help him and humanity.
A comprehensive compilation of melodious devotional songs performed by talented musicians is played in quick succession.
